title: NumPy C-API PyArrayObject reference counting leak during nested exception unwind in ufunc
problem_statement:
### Issue FRONTIER-GH-0186: NumPy C-API PyArrayObject reference counting leak during nested exception unwind in ufunc
Repository: `numpy/numpy`
Category: `Memory Safety & Undefined Behavior`
Target File: `numpy/core/src/multiarray/ctors.c`

#### Problem Description
PyArray_Return leaks underlying descriptor PyArray_Descr reference when PyErr_Occurred before return.
Under high-load production execution, this defect triggers silent data corruption, deadlock, or assertion failure.

#### Concurrency & Invariant Conditions
- Precondition: Invariant validation must be enforced on physical silicon.
- Failure Mode: Reproduction fails with exit code != 0 or thread hang.
- Expected Fix Invariant: Implement Py_XDECREF cleanup on error branch before returning NULL.

#### Reproduction Target
Run: `pytest tests/test_frontier-gh-0186.py -q`
expected_invariant: Implement Py_XDECREF cleanup on error branch before returning NULL.
